##########################################################################
# Eire Reborn - Update 4 (Britannia) effects, generated by tools/gen_script_brit.py
##########################################################################

# County scope (root = the ruler): the county takes the ruler's culture and rises. Every conversion feeds the existing
# re-Celticisation unrest chain; the first one in four years also fires the Saxon Uprising event.
eir_brit_convert_county_effect = {
	set_county_culture = root.culture
	add_county_modifier = {
		modifier = eir_saxon_uprising_modifier
		years = 20
	}
	root = {
		eir_recelt_bump_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag = eir_rising_cd } }
			add_character_flag = {
				flag = eir_rising_cd
				years = 4
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = eir_rising_county
				value = prev
			}
			trigger_event = { id = eir.0800 days = 150 }
		}
	}
}

# Character scope: half of the Irish and Scottish counties of the realm that are not of the ruler's culture take it.
eir_brit_isles_convert_effect = {
	every_sub_realm_county = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				kingdom = title:k_ireland
				kingdom = title:k_scotland
			}
			NOT = { culture = root.culture }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 50
			eir_brit_convert_county_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

# Character scope: the Arthurian legend (only if the legends feature is on).
eir_arthur_legend_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_dlc_feature = legends }
		create_legend_seed = {
			type = heroic
			quality = mythical
			chronicle = great_deed_title
			properties = {
				title = title:e_britannia
				founder = root
			}
		}
	}
}
